Police bust interstate cocaine trafficking rings, arrests made

Dimapur Police have apprehended five individuals in connection with an interstate cocaine trafficking syndicate. Separately, Delhi Police have busted a cocaine trafficking network, leading to the arrest of two Nigerian nationals. The specific details of the operations and the quantity of drugs seized were not provided in the coverage.
